data.narrative:
Valthos is a Seed-stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $30M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of ten comparable companies—two publicly traded (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed and Series A stages within the sector.

Two methods anchor the triangulation. The stage-progression approach applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $30M raised proxy, implying a $75M valuation consistent with Seed-to-next-stage advancement. The peer-median method examines five direct comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed-stage; Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI at Series A ranging $125M–$4.0B), yielding a $1.0B median. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in capital efficiency and market traction within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $64M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $538M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around market validation, regulatory environment, and capital intensity typical of early-stage defense technology. Key variables affecting placement within this range include customer pipeline maturity, go-to-market validation, and the pace of next funding.
